intro: Widgets put a gentle nudge where you'll see it most — on your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Pick the ones you like, then follow the steps to add them.

slides.title: Enter edit mode
slides.body: Touch and hold an empty area of the Home Screen until the icons jiggle, then tap Edit in the top corner and choose Add Widget.

media.description: Long-pressing the Home Screen, tapping Edit, then Add Widget

slides.title: Find the widget
slides.body: Search for the app the widget belongs to — BoringPhone or Screen Time — and swipe through the sizes.

media.description: Searching the widget gallery and browsing sizes

slides.title: Add it
slides.body: Tap Add Widget, drag it where you want it, and tap Done.

media.description: Adding a widget and placing it on the Home Screen

slides.title: Customize your Lock Screen
slides.body: Unlock your phone without leaving the Lock Screen, then touch and hold it. Tap Customize and choose Lock Screen.

media.description: Long-pressing the Lock Screen and entering customization

slides.title: Open the widget area
slides.body: Tap the box below the clock to see the widgets you can add.

media.description: Tapping the widget area under the clock

slides.title: Add it
slides.body: Find BoringPhone in the list, tap the widget you want, then tap Done.

media.description: Adding the BoringPhone widget to the Lock Screen

widgets.title: Reminder
widgets.description: Asks why you're picking up your phone, every time you look at it.

media.description: The BoringPhone reminder widget on the Lock Screen and Home Screen

widgets.widgetText: What did you pick up your phone for?

widgets.title: Clock Mode
widgets.description: One tap opens Clock locked in Guided Access, so your phone can sit on a desk or nightstand without tempting you. Needs Guided Access turned on (see Device Features › Guided Access) and the Clock Mode shortcut installed.

media.description: The Clock Mode widget, and a phone on a nightstand showing only the Clock app

widgets.title: Screen Time
widgets.description: Apple's Screen Time widget keeps today's total in view, so you notice when it's creeping up.

media.description: Home Screen with a Screen Time widget
